channel.title: NaturesMud Nepal — Official Google Merchant & Product Feed
channel.description: Official first-party product feed for NaturesMud Nepal — 32 canonical single-ingredient dehydrated fruits, superfood powders, nuts, seeds, cold-pressed oils, and Himalayan salts.

item.title: Banana Powder
item.description: Nature's Mud Pure Banana Powder is crafted from 100% naturally ripened and dehydrated bananas. Packed with natural potassium, dietary fiber, and essential vitamins. Zero added sugar, zero preservatives, zero artificial additives. Perfectly suited for baby porridge, weaning, morning smoothies, pancake batters, oatmeal, and quick healthy energy drinks.
item.g:product_type: Food, Beverages & Tobacco > Food Items > Powders

item.title: Moringa Leaf Powder
item.description: Handpicked from shade-dried Himalayan Moringa oleifera leaves, NaturesMud Moringa Leaf Powder is a nutrient-dense whole-food green powder. Naturally contains plant amino acids, iron, calcium, and chlorophyll. 100% natural, gluten-free, and additive-free for daily smoothies, dal, and soups.
item.g:product_type: Food, Beverages & Tobacco > Food Items > Powders

item.title: Freeze Dried Avocado Powder
item.description: Proudly harvested and crafted in Nepal! Nature's Mud Freeze Dried Avocado Powder preserves the rich buttery texture and heart-healthy monounsaturated fats of fresh avocados. Processed with advanced gentle freeze-drying technology to preserve raw cellular nutrients, natural potassium, Vitamin E, and dietary fiber. 100% natural, no sugar, no preservatives.
item.g:product_type: Food, Beverages & Tobacco > Food Items > Powders

item.title: Freeze Dried Strawberry Powder
item.description: Indulge in the pure aroma and vibrant ruby color of whole Himalayan strawberries. Nature's Mud Freeze Dried Strawberry Powder delivers real fruit lasting goodness from ripe strawberries to protect natural polyphenols, Vitamin C, and luscious berry flavor. 100% natural, rich in nutrients, zero artificial color, zero synthetic flavor.
item.g:product_type: Food, Beverages & Tobacco > Food Items > Powders

item.title: Dry Figs (Anjeer)
item.description: NaturesMud Dry Figs (Anjeer) are hand-selected, plump, sun-dried whole figs with a chewy texture and natural fruit sweetness. Naturally rich in soluble fiber, iron, calcium, and potassium. 100% natural with 0% added sugar and 0% preservatives, packed in an airtight 200 GM glass jar.
item.g:product_type: Food, Beverages & Tobacco > Food Items > Dried Fruits

item.title: Makhana (Fox Nuts)
item.description: Premium Himalayan Fox Nuts (Makhana). A healthy, crunchy, and lightweight snack loaded with antioxidants, calcium, and protein. Enjoy guilt-free snacking with these beautifully puffed lotus seeds.
item.g:product_type: Food, Beverages & Tobacco > Food Items > Seeds

item.title: Dehydrated Mango
item.description: Golden, intensely flavorful naturally dried mango slices sourced directly from the Tarai lowlands of Nepal. Gently dehydrated at low temperatures with 0 additives and 0 preservatives—pure tropical sweetness packed with Vitamins A & C.
item.g:product_type: Food, Beverages & Tobacco > Food Items > Dried Fruits

item.title: Dehydrated Pineapple

item.g:product_type: Food, Beverages & Tobacco > Food Items > Dried Fruits

item.title: Dehydrated Apple

item.title: Dehydrated Coconut Chips

item.title: Dehydrated Papaya

item.title: Dates Powder
item.description: 100% pure dehydrated date powder made by slowly drying and micro-grinding whole premium dates. The healthiest, unrefined natural sweetener alternative to white table sugar for children, toddlers, and fitness enthusiasts. Loaded with natural potassium, magnesium, iron, and fiber without spiking blood sugar aggressively.
item.g:product_type: Food, Beverages & Tobacco > Food Items > Powders

item.title: Beetroot Powder
item.description: Cold-dehydrated and finely milled from 100% pure Nepali red beetroots (Beta vulgaris).
